name: dmis
description: Disaster Management Information System — npm workspaces monorepo (web + api + shared). Flutter app in apps/mobile is managed separately via pub, not npm.

scripts.//: Scripts below are placeholders wired up as each chunk adds the corresponding app — see README.md for chunk status.
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=services/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:web
